bias.en: Downtrend · dipped to $667, closed back above $700
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 盘中探至 $667，收盘重回 $700 上方

read.en: Micron fell 0.9% on Nov 17 to $712.42, trading $667.00–726.98 and recovering most of an intraday drop of over 6%. It is below the 10-day ($741.9, falling), 5-day ($763.9), 200-day ($768.5), 30-day ($867.0) and 100-day ($933.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 30, below zero, histogram steady; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($848.46), and RSI is 37.5.
read.zh: 美光 11月17日下跌 0.9%，收于 $712.42，盘中区间 $667.00–726.98，收复了盘中逾 6% 跌幅的大部分。股价位于 10 日（$741.9，下行）、5 日（$763.9）、200 日（$768.5）、30 日（$867.0）和 100 日均线（$933.9）下方。MACD 自 10月30日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图平稳；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$848.46），RSI 为 37.5。

read.en: The $667 low pierced the $699.6 and $690 supports intraday, but both held on the close. Resistance is $719–727 (Nov 16 and 10 closes, Nov 17 high), then $733.2–745.6 (Nov 9 close, 10-day, Nov 9–10 highs) and $763.9–768.5 (5 and 200-day). Support is $699.6 (Nov 10 low), then $689.7–690 (Nov 9 low, Nov 6 close) and $667 (Nov 17 low). A close above $727 would target $742–746; below $690, $667.

r.en: Nov 16 close $719.02; Nov 10 close $725.11; Nov 17 high $726.98
